title: Drift0rPatientSource
description: Reference to a patient-record source used for claim provenance.

source_class.description: Epistemic class of the underlying record. Independent of verification_status. Never infer clinician_document or primary_instrument_record from clinical-sounding prose.

legacy_source_bucket.description: Optional legacy path-oriented label (not a substitute for source_class).

is_transcription.description: True when document is a compilation rather than original instrument report.

public_allowed.description: Whether this path may appear in public site artifacts.
